load_and_quantize_model: load and quantize a torch model using bitsandbytes 4-bit or 8-bit configuration with device map dispatch
get_quantized_model_device_map: get an auto-generated device map for a quantized model distributing submodules across available GPUs
replace_with_bnb_layers: replace all torch.nn.Linear layers in a model with bitsandbytes 8-bit or 4-bit quantized linear layers
get_keys_to_not_convert: get a list of module keys to keep in full precision such as lm_head or tied weights for numerical stability
has_4bit_bnb_layers: check if a model contains any bitsandbytes 4-bit or 8-bit quantized linear layers
